name: Klarity Health
one_liner: Book video visits with independent licensed prescribers for ADHD, anxiety and depression; pay per visit or use insurance.
best_for: Adults who want a medication evaluation or refills without a monthly subscription
People who want to choose their own prescriber and compare prices
People with ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, OCD or PTSD who mainly need medication management
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want therapy and medication from one consistent care team
People who need Klarity itself to handle insurance claims (claims go through each provider)
short_description: Telehealth marketplace: you pick an independent nurse practitioner, physician assistant or doctor and pay per visit, either cash or through insurance.
long_description: Klarity Health runs a technology platform that connects patients with independent private practices. You fill in an intake, choose a licensed provider (a nurse practitioner, physician assistant or doctor), and have a video visit; the provider may prescribe medication, give lifestyle advice or refer you elsewhere, and you can book follow-ups. Klarity lists ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, OCD, PTSD and weight management among the conditions treated. Each provider sets their own fees: Klarity takes a $10 non-refundable deposit when you book a first visit and charges the rest 24 hours before; it does not publish a standard price. Some providers take insurance, and HSA/FSA cards are accepted, but Klarity itself does not submit claims or check coverage. Because care comes from separate practices, prescribing and quality vary by provider. No published study of Klarity was found.
patient_summary: You complete a short intake, pick a licensed provider on Klarity, and meet them by video; they can prescribe medication where appropriate and legal, and you book follow-ups as needed. You pay each provider's own per-visit fee (a $10 deposit holds a first visit) or use insurance if that provider takes your plan. There is no subscription.

pricing.starting_price: Pay per visit; each provider sets the fee ($10 deposit to book a first visit); insurance with some providers
pricing.notes: No subscription. The $10 first-visit deposit is non-refundable; the rest is charged 24 hours before the visit. Self-pay no-shows are charged in full. Some providers accept insurance; Klarity does not file claims. HSA/FSA accepted. Klarity does not publish a standard price.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says Klarity does not share or sell PHI, but uses third-party advertising companies whose cookies track visits to its site and others to serve interest-based ads; account and data deletion on request.

faqs.q: How much does Klarity Health cost?
faqs.a: Pay per visit: about $80–$150 first visit, $59–$150 follow-ups. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Klarity Health before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Klarity Health replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Klarity Health connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Klarity Health?
faqs.a: Klarity Health is available on the web.
